name: kbd
description: The Kbd package contains key-table files, console fonts, and keyboard utilities.

installed_descriptions.name: chvt
installed_descriptions.description: Changes the foreground virtual terminal

installed_descriptions.name: deallocvt
installed_descriptions.description: Deallocates unused virtual terminals

installed_descriptions.name: dumpkeys
installed_descriptions.description: Dumps the keyboard translation tables

installed_descriptions.name: fgconsole
installed_descriptions.description: Prints the number of the active virtual terminal

installed_descriptions.name: getkeycodes
installed_descriptions.description: Prints the kernel scancode-to-keycode mapping table

installed_descriptions.name: kbdinfo
installed_descriptions.description: Obtains information about the status of a console

installed_descriptions.name: kbd_mode
installed_descriptions.description: Reports or sets the keyboard mode

installed_descriptions.name: kbdrate
installed_descriptions.description: Sets the keyboard repeat and delay rates

installed_descriptions.name: loadkeys
installed_descriptions.description: Loads the keyboard translation tables

installed_descriptions.name: loadunimap
installed_descriptions.description: Loads the kernel unicode-to-font mapping table

installed_descriptions.name: mapscrn
installed_descriptions.description: An obsolete program that used to load a user-defined output character mapping table into the console driver; this is now done by setfont

installed_descriptions.name: openvt
installed_descriptions.description: Starts a program on a new virtual terminal (VT)

installed_descriptions.name: psfaddtable
installed_descriptions.description: Adds a Unicode character table to a console font

installed_descriptions.name: psfgettable
installed_descriptions.description: Extracts the embedded Unicode character table from a console font

installed_descriptions.name: psfstriptable
installed_descriptions.description: Removes the embedded Unicode character table from a console font

installed_descriptions.name: psfxtable
installed_descriptions.description: Handles Unicode character tables for console fonts

installed_descriptions.name: setfont
installed_descriptions.description: Changes the Enhanced Graphic Adapter (EGA) and Video Graphics Array (VGA) fonts on the console

installed_descriptions.name: setkeycodes
installed_descriptions.description: Loads kernel scancode-to-keycode mapping table entries; this is useful if there are unusual keys on the keyboard

installed_descriptions.name: setleds
installed_descriptions.description: Sets the keyboard flags and Light Emitting Diodes (LEDs)

installed_descriptions.name: setmetamode
installed_descriptions.description: Defines the keyboard meta-key handling

installed_descriptions.name: setvtrgb
installed_descriptions.description: Sets the console color map in all virtual terminals

installed_descriptions.name: showconsolefont
installed_descriptions.description: Shows the current EGA/VGA console screen font

installed_descriptions.name: showkey
installed_descriptions.description: Reports the scancodes, keycodes, and ASCII codes of the keys pressed on the keyboard

installed_descriptions.name: unicode_start
installed_descriptions.description: Puts the keyboard and console in UNICODE mode [Don't use this program unless your keymap file is in the ISO-8859-1 encoding. For other encodings, this utility produces incorrect results.]

installed_descriptions.name: unicode_stop
installed_descriptions.description: Reverts keyboard and console from UNICODE mode
